CanonicalKeywords.rationale: `{ Ethereal, Unplayable }` (Dazed.cs:10-14) == both flags. NOT Eternal, and the sim leaves `eternal` False.

ctor.issue: STATUS / STATUS / NONE map exactly. The canonical energy cost is -1 in C# and 0 in the sim. `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers` returns early on `_base < 0` (CardEnergyCost.cs:100-103), so the game's unplayable card is immune to every cost modifier and keeps reporting -1; the sim runs a base of 0 through the full modifier chain (cards/base.py:222-232). `GetAmountToSpend()` clamps to Math.Max(0, ...) on both sides, so only what is READ diverges. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/ascenders_bane's ctor entry (rule 3). DORMANT: the ported cost readers all filter `> 0` or skip `<= 1` (relics/mummified_hand.py:25, potions.py:168, cards/event_cards.py:328), and events/infested_automaton.py:35 filters pool_card_ids(), which holds no curses or statuses.

OnPlay.rationale: Dazed.cs has no members beyond the three above -- no OnPlay, no OnTurnEndInHand, no vars. It is a pure dead draw that exhausts itself at end of turn via Ethereal. The sim matches.

guards.what: the sim adds `is_unpowered = True` (dazed.py:27), which has no counterpart in Dazed.cs
guards.rationale: Inert: the flag only steers `DamageCmd.deal`'s prop inference (cmds.py:44-50) and Dazed deals no damage. Same inert extra as card/ascenders_bane, card/clumsy, card/curse_of_the_bell.
